label: msg_ui_tips_HOWTO_01_text_01
text:
You can press the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]X Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to open the main menu.

Select the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Save [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]option from this menu to save all
the progress you’ve made on your adventure so far.

When you open up your Bag, you’ll find some
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Key Items[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] inside, including your [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Adventure Guide[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

Check it out whenever you want to review handy tips
like these that you receive along your adventure!

label: msg_ui_tips_YMAP_01_text_01
text:
The handy Rotom Phone is a popular item
used throughout the Paldea region!

Adding apps to it gives a Trainer access
to a variety of useful functions.

label: msg_ui_tips_YMAP_01_text_02
text:
Using the map app, you can find useful information
about the Paldea region. If you move the map cursor
over your own icon and then move the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Right Stick[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
from side to side, you’ll rotate your own view along
with the map. Handy for getting yourself oriented!

label: msg_ui_tips_YMAP_01_text_03
text:
You can use the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Left Stick[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to move the magnifying
glass around the map and find locations.
Select a location by pressing the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]A Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)],
and you can set it as your next destination.

label: msg_ui_tips_YMAP_01_text_05
text: The [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Flying Taxi[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] service can take you to [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]some places[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\nyou’ve visited before. Places that you can fly to are\nindicated with a [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]feather mark[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]. Try taking a flight!

label: msg_ui_tips_POKEDEX_01_text_01
text:
Press the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]− Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to open the Pokédex
app on your Rotom Phone in a flash!

You can also navigate to your Pokédex by
pressing the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]X Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from the map app.

label: msg_ui_tips_POKEDEX_02_text_01
text:
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Battle[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] or [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]catch[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] Pokémon to compile volumes in your
Pokédex app—with fancier covers for Pokémon you’ve
caught. Open up your Pokédex to view all the volumes
you’ve collected on a digital shelf and check out what
rewards you can earn by pressing the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]X Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

label: msg_ui_tips_POKEDEX_02_text_02
text:
Press the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]+ Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] when looking at a Pokémon you’ve
registered in your Pokédex, and you can check that
Pokémon’s [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]habitat[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to learn more about where they can
be found and when they’re active. Explore different
areas as you adventure, and meet tons of Pokémon!

label: msg_ui_tips_BOX_01_text_01
text:
You can keep six Pokémon in your party at once.
Any other Pokémon can be sent to your Pokémon
Boxes for safekeeping.

From the main menu, you can select your [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Boxes[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
to open them up. From there, choose Pokémon
to swap in and out of your current team.

label: msg_ui_tips_POKEGETTUTORIAL_01_text_01
text: You can try to catch a wild Pokémon you are battling\nby pressing the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]X Button [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]and throwing a Poké Ball.

label: msg_ui_tips_POKEGETTUTORIAL_01_text_04
text: When you’re having a hard time catching a Pokémon,\ntry to [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]deal damage[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to it before throwing another Poké\nBall. That should give you a better chance of success!

label: msg_ui_tips_POKEBATTLE_01_text_01
text:
The Pokémon you see wandering around in tall grass,
caves, and elsewhere are [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]wild Pokémon[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

When you run into a wild Pokémon,
a Pokémon battle will begin!

label: msg_ui_tips_POKEBATTLE_01_text_02
text:
You can also start a battle by looking toward a wild
Pokémon and [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]throwing one of your Poké Balls[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] at it
by using the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]ZR Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]! Try this tactic out to battle
Pokémon that are up in trees or flying in the sky!

label: msg_ui_tips_LETSGO_01_text_01
text:
Pressing the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]R Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] is a quick and easy way to tell
your [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]lead Pokémon[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], “All right, buddy—[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Let’s Go![VAR 0xFF00(0000)]”
Once you give the go-ahead, your Pokémon will
set out on its own to [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]battle [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]nearby Pokémon
or [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]pick up items[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] it finds in the area.

label: msg_ui_tips_LETSGO_01_text_02
text:
When your Pokémon is low on energy—which happens
when its HP is low—it won’t be able to go exploring
on its own. So if your Pokémon gets [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]weak[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], try to
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]heal[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] it up with a Potion or some other item!

label: msg_ui_tips_LETSGO_01_text_03
text:
When your Pokémon starts a battle while exploring
on its own, you won’t need to give any orders.
It can battle on its own with [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Auto Battles[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], meaning
that you can keep searching the area for new
discoveries while watching over it from nearby.

label: msg_ui_tips_LETSGO_01_text_04
text:
Auto Battles will be decided by the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]strength [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]and
the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]types [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]of the Pokémon taking part in the battle,
so keep that in mind when you’re choosing which
of your Pokémon to send out on its own!

label: msg_ui_tips_TREASUREHUNT_01_text_01
text:
The [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Treasure Hunt[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] has finally begun! This special
event is held by the academy to encourage students
to set out on their own and learn for themselves.
You’re free to decide where you want to go
as you search for a treasure all your own!

label: msg_ui_tips_DESTINATION_01_text_01
text:
When you don’t know where to go next, you can ask
for help at any [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Pokémon Center[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]. The staff there can
give you [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]tips[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] about where you might want to try.
Plus, they’ll register their suggested destinations
on your Rotom Phone for you.

label: msg_ui_tips_CROSSKEY_01_text_01
text:
There are all kinds of handy functions registered
to your directional buttons. Check them out!

[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]↑ Use emotes  [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]/  [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]↓ Open camera app
← Change outfit or look [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]/  [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]→ Check notices[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]

label: msg_ui_tips_LOCKON_01_text_01
text:
If you press the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]ZL Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], you can [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]lock on [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]to a
nearby Pokémon—meaning you’ll keep your sights
set on it. Once you’re locked on, throwing a Poké
Ball with the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]ZR Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] will let you start a battle
with the Pokémon you were aiming for.

label: msg_ui_tips_QUICKRECOVERY_01_text_01
text:
The Auto Heal feature will automatically select items
from your Bag and use them to heal your Pokémon.
To use Auto Heal, highlight the Pokémon you want to
heal from the main menu and press the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]− Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

label: msg_ui_tips_QUICKRECOVERY_01_text_02
text:
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Auto Heal will use up items in the following order:[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
1. Potions
2. Fresh Waters
3. Soda Pops
4. Super Potions
5. Lemonades
6. Moomoo Milks
7. Hyper Potions

label: msg_ui_tips_HIDEWALK_01_text_01
text: You can use the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]B Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to crouch. When you’re\ncrouched down low in tall grass, it will become\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]harder for wild Pokémon to notice you[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

label: msg_ui_tips_HIDEWALK_01_text_02
text:
If you can get close to a Pokémon without it noticing
you and then [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]throw a Poké Ball[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] using the ZR Button,
you can [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]catch it off guard[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]. You’ll be able to act first
in the battle, giving you a nice advantage!

label: msg_ui_tips_POKERUSH_01_text_01
text: You may sometimes see [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Pokémon icons[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] on your map.\nWhen you do, it means you [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]may be able to find those[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Pokémon[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] in that area, so try to search them out!

label: msg_ui_tips_WAZAREMEMBER_01_text_01
text:
If Pokémon skip learning moves or forget old moves,
they can learn them again! Open the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]main menu[VAR 0xFF00(0000)],
select a Pokémon, then select [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Check summary[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]. On the
status screen, go to the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Moves and Stats[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] tab to check
your Pokémon’s moves and help it [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]remember[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] some!

label: msg_ui_tips_UNIONCIRCLE_01_text_01
text: Using the Union Circle, you can [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]play together[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]with friends[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] as you adventure!

label: msg_ui_tips_UNIONCIRCLE_01_text_02
text:
If you want to play with [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]nearby friends[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], you should
leave your internet connection in [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Offline Mode[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].
If you want to play with [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]faraway friends[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], change
to [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Online Mode[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]. You can connect to or disconnect
from the internet from within the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Poké Portal[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

label: msg_ui_tips_UNIONCIRCLE_01_text_03
text:
When you want to invite friends to play
together with you, form a group and then
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]tell your friends the Link Code you set[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].
When you want to join a friend’s group, you’ll
need to [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]enter the Link Code they share with you[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

label: msg_ui_tips_UNIONCIRCLE_01_text_04
text:
Just remember that you won’t be able to take part
in [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Link Battles[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Link Trades[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], or [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Tera Raid Battles[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
with anyone but your fellow group members
while you’re playing together as a group.

label: msg_ui_tips_TTYPE_01_text_01
text:
Here in the Paldea region, Pokémon can crystallize
through a strange phenomenon. The people call this
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Terastallizing[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]. You can Terastallize your Pokémon by
selecting the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]TERASTALLIZE! [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]button in battle.

label: msg_ui_tips_TTYPE_01_text_02
text: When a Pokémon Terastallizes, its type changes to\nits [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Tera Type[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]. Moves of the same type as this Tera\nType will become much more powerful than usual.

label: msg_ui_tips_TTYPE_01_text_03
text:
After Terastallizing a Pokémon once, you [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]won’t be[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]able to Terastallize a Pokémon again until you heal[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]up at a Pokémon Center[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], so use this strategy wisely
to seize victory in battles!

label: msg_ui_tips_PHOTOMODE_01_text_01
text: You can [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]start up the camera app[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] by pressing the\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Down Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]. Move the camera about freely to snap\nshots of all kinds of places and Pokémon you see!

label: msg_ui_tips_PHOTOMODE_01_text_02
text: When you have the camera app open, press the\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Y Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to flip the camera around and take photos of\nyourself. Press it again to return the camera to normal.

label: msg_ui_tips_PHOTOMODE_01_text_03
text: When you want to take fancy or funny photos,\ntry pressing the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Left Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] or the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Right Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\nto [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]change filters[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

label: msg_ui_tips_SHOPWAZAMACHINE_01_text_02
text:
To make TMs, you’ll need to gather up [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]materials[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
from Pokémon and earn [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]League Points[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], or [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]LP[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].
The range of TMs you can make will expand as
you pick up new TMs or receive them from others
during your adventure.

label: msg_ui_tips_POKEPICNIC_01_text_01
text:
You can enjoy picnics together with the Pokémon
in your party. If you’re playing in a group with
friends through the Union Circle, you can also
have [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]picnics with friends[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

label: msg_ui_tips_POKEPICNIC_01_text_02
text:
You won’t be able to set up a picnic table in the
middle of a town or where there isn’t enough space
to get everything out—or on inclines, where things
might go sliding off your table! Look for [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]wide-open,[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]level spots outside of towns[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] when you want to picnic!

label: msg_ui_tips_COOKING_01_title_02
text: What You Need to Make Sandwiches

label: msg_ui_tips_COOKING_01_text_01
text:
Try whipping up a delicious sandwich by piling your
favorite ingredients up on sliced bread.
If you’re picnicking with friends, you can take part in
sandwich prep together as well!

label: msg_ui_tips_COOKING_01_text_02
text:
The [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]sandwich ingredients[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] and [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]sandwich picks
[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]you need to put together a great sandwich can
be [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]bought [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]at various shops found in towns and
cities. Stock up on your favorite ingredients
and picks, and see what you can create.

label: msg_ui_tips_COOKING_01_text_03
text:
In [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Recipe Mode[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], ingredients are selected for you. All
you have to do is skillfully arrange them on the bread
to make the sandwich in the recipe. But if you drop
an ingredient and don’t get everything the recipe calls
for, you may end up making something different.

label: msg_ui_tips_COOKING_01_text_04
text:
Dig in to a nice meal at a restaurant or picnic, and you
and your Pokémon can gain [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Meal Powers[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]. Many
Meal Powers have an associated type, meaning they’ll
only affect Pokémon of that type. The effects of a
Meal Power will be impacted by [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]what’s in a given dish[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

label: msg_ui_tips_COOKING_01_text_05
text:
･ [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Egg Power[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]: More likely to find Pokémon Eggs
 ･ [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Catching Power[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]: More likely catches will succeed
 ･ [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Exp. Point Power[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]: More Exp. Points gained
 ･ [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Item Drop Power[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]: More materials found after battle
 ･ [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Raid Power[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]: More rewards from Tera Raid Battles
 ･ [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Title Power[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]: More likely to find Pokémon with titles
 ･ [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Sparkling Power[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]: More likely to find Shiny Pokémon
 ･ [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Humungo Power[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]: More likely to find large Pokémon
 ･ [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Teensy Power[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]: More likely to find small Pokémon
 ･ [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Encounter Power[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]: More likely to find certain types

label: msg_ui_tips_POKEWASH_01_text_01
text:
When your Pokémon get dirty, you can give them
a nice [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]wash [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]to have them looking fresh and clean.
Doing so can have all kinds of nice benefits,
including [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]restoring their HP[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] or making them
feel [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]more friendly [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]toward you.

label: msg_ui_tips_LEAGUCARD_01_text_01
text: If you select your [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Profile[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from the map app, you’ll\nfind various [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]records from your adventure[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]. You can\nalso check your [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]profile picture and Trainer icon[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

label: msg_ui_tips_LEAGUCARD_01_text_02
text: Both your [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]profile picture[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] and your [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Trainer icon[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] can be\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]updated [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]freely by taking photos with the camera app.\nEnjoy crafting a profile that’s all your own!

label: msg_ui_tips_RAIDSPOT_01_text_01
text:
All around Paldea, you may spot gleaming [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]crystals[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
emitting brilliant beams of light. If you investigate
one, you’ll be able to take on a [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Tera Raid Battle[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
and try to defeat a powerful Tera Pokémon.

label: msg_ui_tips_RAIDBATTLE_01_text_01
text:
In Tera Raid Battles, you’ll work together with
other Trainers to battle [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]powerful Tera Pokémon[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].
You can battle alongside [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]faraway[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] friends while
you’re in [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Online Mode[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] or [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]nearby[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] friends while
you’re in [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Offline Mode[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

label: msg_ui_tips_RAIDBATTLE_01_text_02
text:
These battles will pit you against Tera Pokémon with
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]rare Tera Types[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]. If you and your allies can work
together to defeat the Tera Pokémon, you’ll have
a chance to [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]catch[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] it and also get [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]special items[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

label: msg_ui_tips_RAIDBATTLE_02_list
text: The Rules of Tera Raid Battles

label: msg_ui_tips_RAIDBATTLE_02_title_01
text: The Rules of Tera Raid Battles

label: msg_ui_tips_RAIDBATTLE_02_text_01
text:
In a Tera Raid Battle, you’ll try to defeat a Tera
Pokémon within a time limit. If your Pokémon is
knocked out, it will [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]be revived[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] after a while—but
you’ll also [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]take a time penalty[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], so try to avoid
letting your Pokémon faint, if you can!

label: msg_ui_tips_RAIDBATTLE_02_text_02
text:
You can also perform a special action in Tera Raid
Battles: [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]cheering[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]! By cheering for your side, you
can do things like boosting the stats of the Pokémon
on your side or helping them recover their health.
You can perform cheers three times per battle.

label: msg_ui_tips_DANBATTLE_01_text_01
text:
Send your Pokémon out with the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]R Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to try
to defeat [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]a set number[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] of Team Star’s Pokémon
before time runs out! When you’re taking on
the challenge of a Star Barrage, you can have
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]three Pokémon [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]out at the same time.

label: msg_ui_tips_DANBATTLE_01_text_02
text: You lose in a Star Barrage if all your Pokémon\nget too worn out to battle or if [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]time runs out[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

label: msg_ui_tips_DANBATTLE_01_text_03
text:
If one of your Pokémon can no longer battle, you
can help it [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]recover HP[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] by using a [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]vending machine[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

If you decide you want to [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]give up[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] before
time runs out, press the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Y Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

label: msg_ui_tips_BATTLESTADIUM_02_text_01
text: In Casual Battles, you can enjoy battling\nwith all kinds of Trainers from all over\nthe world without too much pressure.

label: msg_ui_tips_BATTLESTADIUM_02_text_02
text:
When you want to take part in a Casual Battle, make
sure that [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]all the Pokémon on your Battle Team[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] are of
a [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]different species[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

Make sure that no Pokémon on your Battle Team are
holding the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]same item[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]. They all have to be different!

Beyond these rules, there are no restrictions on what
Pokémon can take part in a Casual Battle.

label: msg_ui_tips_BATTLESTADIUM_03_text_01
text: Ranked Battles allow you to battle against\nother Trainers around the world to see\nwho can reach the highest rank.

label: msg_ui_tips_BATTLESTADIUM_03_text_02
text:
If you [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]win[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] in Ranked Battles, you can go up in rank.

Try your hardest to see how high a rank you can
reach before each battle season ends!

label: msg_ui_tips_BATTLESTADIUM_03_text_03
text:
The highest rank you can reach is called [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]MAX RANK[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].
Once you reach this rank, you’ll battle to decide
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]your place [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]within that lofty group. Try to reach the
highest place you can before the season’s end!

label: msg_ui_tips_BATTLESTADIUM_03_text_04
text:
The Pokémon that can take part in Ranked Battles
may change [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]with each season[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

Look for [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]news[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] shared in the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Poké Portal[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to learn
more about current or upcoming rules.

label: msg_ui_tips_BATTLESTADIUM_04_text_01
text:
In Online Competitions, you battle other Trainers
to try to reach first place. You’ll earn yourself
a rating, which goes up when you win battles.
In order to take part in any competition, you’ll
have to register to [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]enter the competition[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] first!

label: msg_ui_tips_BATTLESTADIUM_04_text_02
text:
With [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Friendly Competitions[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], any player can start up
their [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]very own competition[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] and decide how long it
will be held and what the rules are.
By sharing the competition ID with your friends,
you can all enjoy battling together!

label: msg_ui_tips_BATTLESTADIUM_04_text_03
text:
You can also take part in [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Official Competitions[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]—
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]special competitions [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]with specific, preset rules.
These competitions’ schedules and rules will be
shared in the News section in the Poké Portal.

label: msg_ui_tips_BATTLESTADIUM_04_text_04
text: To take part in a competition, you’ll need to\ncomplete your [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]entry[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] and [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]register your Battle Team\n[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]at the same time.

label: msg_ui_tips_MYSTERY_01_text_01
text:
With a Surprise Trade, you don’t choose who you’ll
trade with or what you’ll get. Just choose a Pokémon
you’re willing to part with from your Boxes, and your
trade will be carried out [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]automatically[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]. You’ll need
an [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]internet connection[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to use this feature.

label: msg_ui_tips_RIDEON_01_text_01
text: Press the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]+ Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to jump onto Koraidon—\nyou’ll find you can get around more quickly.

label: msg_ui_tips_RIDEON_01_text_02
text:
When you’re on Koraidon’s back, you can press
the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]B Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to have it jump, allowing you to [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]leap[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]over obstacles[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] in your path. Press the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]+ Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]again [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]to get off of Koraidon and walk.

label: msg_ui_tips_RIDEON_02_text_01
text: Press the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]+ Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to jump onto Miraidon—\nyou’ll find you can get around more quickly.

label: msg_ui_tips_RIDEON_02_text_02
text:
When you’re on Miraidon’s back, you can press
the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]B Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to have it jump, allowing you to [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]leap[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
